source.title: CraftWise Disenchant.lua: reader for Disenchantry measured sample SavedVariables on WoW Forever
source.author: velibkolay/CraftWise

quote: account wide, recorded on Forever only; read only, never written
notes: NEW cross-project source-code evidence for the collector-acquisition question; NO new player-material cohort. CraftWise's Disenchant.lua explicitly documents its read-only source DisenchantryDB.disenchantSamples as recorded on WoW Forever only. Its documented key is <clientVersion>:<clientBuild>:<itemID>:<quality>:<baseItemLevel>:<classID>:<normal|salvager>; a sample holds count and per-materialID {total,hits,min,max}. Source code also checks sample version/build prefix and excludes other builds, while keeping the Forever-only Arcane Salvager buff separate from normal samples. These are SOURCE-DESCRIBED FIELDS of a Forever consumer, NOT verified contents of Disenchantry Retail 12.1.5 v1.2.6, not a player export, and not transferable to Midnight drop rates. Specifically, do not turn CraftWise computed chance/quantity, sample prefixes, or Forever buff state into measured Midnight events. There is no attested per-event itemLink bonus, gear scaled ilvl at cast, profession skill/specialization, patch-matched Retail original event receipt, or histogram of zero and positive yield in the inspected third-party reader. Retail collector support remains unverified; seek original addon Retail source/SavedVariables or witnessed event file before proposing numeric import.
lookingFor: Retail 12.1.5 original per-operation disenchant capture with input itemLink/bonus and actual ilvl, materialID-ranked outputs, zero-inclusive event stream, skill/specialization and build; independent 272246 ilvl305 successful disenchant and 237362 rank-specific prospecting
